titles.title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to increase the highest rate of income tax imposed on individual taxpayers to 39.6 percent, and to deposit the amounts received as a result of such increase into the Social Security trust funds.

To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to increase the highest rate of income tax imposed on individual taxpayers to 39.6 percent, and to deposit the amounts received as a result of such increase into the Social Security trust funds.
